needs.semantics: characteristics.ts:411 `side` is `opps.some(...)`, so every 'opponent'/'any' condition is existential; there is no universal form and no AND combinator (only 'or'). 'if each player has 10 or less life' therefore has no faithful encoding - the closest one fires whenever a single player is low.
